data.scope: A curated reading layer of high-consequence primary works, books and reports, plus selected field-shaping ArXiv papers from 2010-2026. Links distinguish public-domain, open, author-hosted, free-to-read and publisher-record access; inclusion does not establish priority, independent replication or a uniquely causal graph edge.

tiers.core: Distinct, durable development added at the map's normal granularity.
tiers.specialist: Real development included for completeness; narrower than the map's usual headline nodes.
tiers.emerging: Recent development whose long-term importance remains provisional.
tiers.integrated: Important paper lineage represented inside an existing node rather than duplicated.
